channel.title: The Local Europe - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local Europe (thelocal.com)

item.title: Inside Austria: where to go in Vienna with kids when it’s too cold to be outside
item.description: If you're running out of ideas on what to do in Vienna during these cold days, The Local Austria's editor Amanda Previdelli has a couple of suggestions that are great for grown-ups too.

item.title: UK confirms ETA price hike for European travellers as rules set to toughen
item.description: The UK government is set to further increase the cost of the Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA) for travellers from Europe, coinciding with the implementation of tougher entry rules.

item.title: Danone expands recall of infant formula batches in Europe
item.description: French food giant Danone recalled batches of infant formula in Britain, Spain, Croatia and Slovenia over the possible presence of a toxin, food safety authorities said on Friday, expanding the measure across Europe.

item.title: In show of support, France and Canada open consulates in Greenland
item.description: France and Canada, which both oppose US President Donald Trump's claim to Greenland, opened consulates in the Danish autonomous territory's capital on Friday, in a show of support for the local government.

item.title: What do Europeans really think about immigration?
item.description: Growing political polarisation means that debate about immigration is boiled down to 'pro' or 'anti'-immigration positions, but new surveys reveal that European public opinion is a little more nuanced than that.

item.title: 'Sabotage' hits Italy trains on Olympic opening weekend
item.description: Italian Transport Minister Matteo Salvini expressed concern Saturday at "serious incidents of sabotage" that delayed trains in central Italy, suggesting they could be linked the opening of the Winter Olympics.

item.title: INTERVIEW: 'Receiving Austrian citizenship was an emotional moment'
item.description: Applying to become an Austrian citizen is a difficult process and usually involves foreigners having to renounce their original nationality. One reader shares her naturalisation journey and the complicated feelings that go with it.

item.title: The ultimate guide to Spain's craziest carnivals
item.description: As carnival gets underway across Spain this week, The Local gives you the rundown on where to see some of Spain's wackiest celebrations, including everything from mythical creatures to mud-slinging.

item.title: Spain's train drivers call off three-day strike after safety deal
item.description: Unions and Spanish train drivers have called off the rail strike that began this Monday and was initially scheduled to last until Wednesday February 11th.

item.title: Avalanche risk: Is it no longer safe to ski off piste in the French Alps?
item.description: The number of deaths caused by avalanches in the French Alps continues to rise with four more skiers killed in early February. So is it still safe to ski off-piste in France?
